subject: Target $/1M token comparison: open-hosts vs Redwood
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>
To: Leah Kim <leah.kim@finexa.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@finexa.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 04 Dec 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap + preliminary $/1M comparisons

Hi Leah / Samir — thanks again for the 30-min call this morning. Quick written recap so we all have the same record and clear next steps.

Call summary (high level)
- Primary use: conversational customer support automations + nightly batch summarization of transcripts.
- Expected steady-state volume: ~150M tokens/month in 2028 (ramping from 20M in Q1 to 150M by Q4).
- Pilot size: 8–10M tokens/month for 6 weeks to validate latency & quality.
- Hard budget range expressed on the call: $300–$450 per 1M tokens (Finexa target).

Preliminary $/1M token snapshot (per our quick comp):
- OpenAI (hosted dev plan proxies): ~1,200 $/1M tokens (public host list estimates)
- Anthropic (hosted): ~1,500 $/1M tokens
- Large open-model hosts (quantized + infra): ~600 $/1M tokens
- Redwood (committed tiers, non-optimized baseline): 450 $/1M tokens
- Redwood (with batching + KV cache + quantization playbook): targetable 300–350 $/1M tokens for committed volumes + 12‑month rollout

Notes on assumptions: these numbers are ballpark and intentionally conservative (we used 8K context mixes and included expected engineering support/SLAs for committed tiers). Open-model hosts vary a lot by quantization and instance selection — we'll walk this through with your infra team if you want to model true P95 latency vs raw $/1M.

Attachments: I attached (1) your usage forecast spreadsheet we discussed (finexa-usage-forecast.xlsx) and (2) a one-pager comparison I put together (redwood-vs-hosts-1m-comparison.pdf).

Suggested next steps
1) Finexa: confirm target anchor in the budget band ($/1M) and whether pilot must be <= $400/1M to proceed.
2) Redwood: run a profile for your representative prompt set (we'll need a sample transcript file + expected concurrency) — I'll coordinate with Priyom to get this scheduled.
3) Commercial: we'll propose 3 pricing levers for the pilot vs committed (pilot rate, committed rate, enterprise committed with SLA + fallback).

Decision milestone: if Finexa is comfortable with a pilot budget anchor by Dec 10th we can start provisioning pilot capacity the week of Jan 3rd.

Happy to jump on another call to walk the numbers.

Thanks,
Laura
Laura Bennett
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

- finexa-usage-forecast.xlsx (spreadsheet, 24KB)
- redwood-vs-hosts-1m-comparison.pdf (PDF, 120KB)

From: Leah Kim <leah.kim@finexa.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@finexa.com>
Date: Fri, 04 Dec 2027 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + preliminary $/1M comparisons

Laura — thanks for the clear recap and the attachments. Couple of quick clarifications from our side:

- The budget band we mentioned was for our production rollout (post-pilot). For pilot spend we have a separate allocation of ~$12k total (so depending on the pilot length we can afford the higher pilot rate you propose for 6 weeks).
- Our internal procurement wants to see a committed 12-month price scenario (we expect to commit to 120M tokens/month by the end of 2028 if the pilot succeeds).
- Can you break out the comparison to show "price after tech optimizations" vs "raw hosted price"? The difference is material for our CFO — we saw your note but would like the specific delta numbers and the levers that create them (batching, quantization, caching).

We'll aim to confirm the anchor budget for production by Dec 9 so Dec 10 milestone is realistic.

Also copying our SRE who will want to coordinate the sample payload:
Samir Patel <samir.patel@finexa.com>

Thanks,
Leah
Leah Kim
Head of AI Products, Finexa
leah.kim@finexa.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 04 Dec 2027 11:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + preliminary $/1M comparisons (internal)

Laura / Priyom — quick internal note on pricing posture and suggested structure for the Finexa commercial ask.

Quick unit-econ assumptions I ran (very conservative):
- GPU amortized + infra + support: ~$0.12 / 1k tokens = $120 / 1M tokens baseline for efficient open models (quantized).
- Additional margin + managed service + SLA: +$180–$230 / 1M tokens -> total 300–350 $/1M for committed program.
- Hosted incumbents include their own margins and model costs, which is why their sticker is higher.

Commercial proposal (three buckets) — to present to Finexa:
1) Pilot (time-limited, baseline support): 850 $/1M tokens — covers engineering ramp and no-commit support (6 weeks)
2) Committed tier (12-month, 3-month ramp): 450 $/1M tokens — includes standard SLA, ops onboarding, and 10% usage discount at >100M/mo
3) Enterprise committed (12+ month + 12-month ramp + SLA + private routing): 350 $/1M tokens — includes advanced observability and a rollback/fallback policy to lower-cost model variants

Operational levers we should map explicitly in the one-pager: batching window policy, KV cache scope (session vs global), quantization level (INT8 vs INT4) and expected per-token savings. Priyom — can your team create 2 slides showing expected $/1M impact for each lever using Finexa's traffic shape? I can own the commercial wording.

Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.inference.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>
To: Leah Kim <leah.kim@finexa.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@finexa.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 04 Dec 2027 14:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + preliminary $/1M comparisons

Leah / Samir — great, appreciated. Short answers + next steps: 

1) Pilot spend: confirmed you have ~$12k allocation. We'll size the pilot so the total spend stays inside that band (Ben suggested 850 $/1M for pilot rate) — we'll propose two pilot sizing options in the formal proposal: (A) 6-week focused pilot ~10M tokens (B) 4-week focused pilot ~8M tokens.
2) 12-month committed scenario: Ben and Priyom will produce the 3-tier commercial wording and a slide that decomposes the $/1M delta by lever (batching / quantization / cache). Expect the internal deliverable by EOD Monday (Dec 7).
3) Sample payload: Samir — can you drop one week of representative transcripts to the Drive link below (or attach to a reply)? We'll use those to run the pilot cost/latency profile.

Drive link for sample payload: https://drive.google.com/finexa-sample-payloads (or reply with attachment).

Decision timeline: Finexa to confirm production anchor by Dec 9 so we can finalize the proposal and lock pilot dates. If you confirm by then we will target provisioning for the first week of Jan.

I'll follow up with a formal proposal (price table + pilot scope) once Ben/Priyom complete the slides.

Thanks again — Laura
